disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder. Clinical cohort of autistic individuals from ABIDE I and II. Primary analyses conducted in males only.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Autism spectrum disorder ('autism') is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by substantial behavioral and neuroanatomical heterogeneity."; "normative modeling on CT and subcortical parcellations (N autism = 690, N NAI = 744)"
disorder-name.location: Meijer2024.pdf.md: Abstract, L17; Method / Participants, L59

dataset-of-origin.detail: Combined ABIDE I (17 sites; 539 autism, 573 NAI) and ABIDE II (19 sites; 521 autism, 593 NAI). Sites with same/similar protocols were merged across ABIDE I and II.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "We combined the ABIDE repositories I (Di Martino et al., 2014) and II (Di Martino et al., 2017). ABIDE I includes a total of 1,112 participants (539 autism, 573 NAI) from 17 different sites, and ABIDE II includes 1,114 participants (521 autism, 593 NAI) from 19 different sites."

age.detail: Demographics for autism group (N=861, males only) before analysis-specific exclusion criteria (Table 1). The NM-specific clinical cohort was N=690 (age range 5-64); separate mean/SD not reported for this subsample.
age.supporting_text: "Age M=16.12, SD=8.88, Range 5.1-64" (Table 1); "a sample of 690 autistic and 744 NAI between 5 and 64 years who were included in the normative modeling analysis"
age.location: Meijer2024.pdf.md: Method / Table 1, L63-L71; Method / Participants, L59

sex.detail: Primary analyses were conducted in males only. Females were excluded due to scarce availability across sites (N autism females=130, N NAI females=280). Table 1 demographics (N=861) are all-male. The NM clinical cohort consisted of 690 males. Supplementary analyses including both sexes used N autism=790 (690 males, 100 females).
sex.supporting_text: "primary analyses were conducted in males only due to limited sample size of females (N autism = 130, N NAI = 280)"
sex.location: Meijer2024.pdf.md: Method / Participants, L59-L73; ABN-2023-0282_Suppl.docx.md: Supplementary Methods / Normative modeling, L63
